caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned at a slight angle, so that both the front and one side of the chair are visible. The chair has a simple structure with a light-colored wooden frame, consisting of four straight, cylindrical legs connected by horizontal supports near the base. The seat of the chair is composed of a woven pattern made from darker material, contrasting with the lighter wood of the frame. The backrest is made up of two wide, horizontal wooden slats, and the vertical posts of the backrest extend above the seat and slightly curve backward. The image is rendered in muted, natural tones of beige and brown on an off-white background, with the artist’s name, "Kate Davis," written in small text to the lower right of the chair.
title: Laced Chair
